name: The Breaking of the Hold & Defensive Wall
narrative: Kael violently thrashes, breaking one arm free from the hold and striking Marcus across the collarbone. Marcus's 'Will to Live' trait rolls against its 25% failure threshold (Roll: 0.62 >= 0.25): the survival instinct holds. Marcus absorbs the kinetic blow, but his physical vitality takes the blunt trauma, dropping to 18. Rather than escalating into mutual slaughter, Lyra and Dr. Harlan envelop Kael from behind, wrapping a heavy wet linen canvas around his torso, finally terminating the struggle through total mechanical immobilization.
